subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should an omitted `agents.defaults.sandbox.backend` remain the shipped Docker default, or may OpenClaw automatically substitute Podman when Docker is unavailable?
rationale: This is a permanent default and sandbox security-boundary choice affecting existing configurations; implementation correctness cannot determine whether silent backend substitution is intended product behavior.

options.title: Require explicit Podman
options.body: Preserve Docker for omitted configuration and require users to set `backend: "podman"` before entering the Podman security boundary.

options.title: Approve automatic fallback
options.body: Adopt Docker-then-Podman selection as a new default only with explicit owner approval plus fresh-install, upgrade, policy, and live security proof.

recommendation.title: Require explicit Podman
recommendation.body: Preserve Docker for omitted configuration and require users to set `backend: "podman"` before entering the Podman security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance is repeated ownership of sandbox isolation, Docker security, and runtime lifecycle behavior.
